questions.question: The aits work (@aeye/ollama, System One decide, maxQuestions, image embeddings, resources image links) is uncommitted on aits branch `harness`. What now?

options.label: Commit locally on harness, no push/tag
Commit and push the branch (no tag)

questions.question: Harness has 6 new local commits (beb633b … c947bad), plus ayepi 0855f3b. Push?

questions.question: A fresh hub (or an old `enabled:false` setting) now suggests nothing until an admin picks a decision model or an LLM. Keep that default?

options.label: Default to an LLM with the chat's cheap model

questions.question: SSO sign-in only completes when the hub is opened at HARNESS_URL; at the LAN IP or dev port it fails with 'started in another browser'. OK?

options.label: Redirect to HARNESS_URL before starting sign-in
options.description: Other origins bounce to the canonical URL first, so it just works.

options.label: Yes, add hub fns for it

questions.question: Undo before choosing a variant leaves the variants' effects (writes they made) in place. What should it do?

options.label: Keep effects, but list them in the undo notice
Undo each variant's undoable effects too

options.label: Stop interrupts at once; panel via long-press/menu

questions.question: An api fn for a service the person isn't connected to now fails inside the run (`not-connected`), so a write fn may ask for approval first and then fail. Check before approval?

options.label: Check the connection before asking approval
